Question: Assalamualaikum 1-My student wants to know the meaning of a dream. He saw a dream that there were alot of spiders (dangerous and non dangerous) and spider webs in his room,he killed most of the spiders and some were left to kill then he woke up what does the dream mean? Answer ID: 15114 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1765/1426=H/1430) The student shall get rid of greed in worldly matters and shall advance in good deeds in-sha-Allah provided he pays special attention to follow sunnah in each matter. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
